question: Show the Name of all product categories
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM ProductCategory;

question: Show the Name of all products that are red
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Product WHERE Color = 'Red';

question: List the Name and ListPrice of all products with list price greater than 1000
expected_sql: SELECT Name, ListPrice FROM Product WHERE ListPrice > 1000;

question: List the Name and ListPrice of the top 5 most expensive products
expected_sql: SELECT Name, ListPrice FROM Product ORDER BY ListPrice DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show the FirstName, LastName, CompanyName, EmailAddress, and Phone of the customer named Orlando Gee
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, CompanyName, EmailAddress, Phone FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Orlando' AND LastName = 'Gee';

question: List the AddressLine1 and PostalCode of all addresses in Seattle
expected_sql: SELECT AddressLine1, PostalCode FROM Address WHERE City = 'Seattle';

question: Get the Name and Size of all products that have size 'M'
expected_sql: SELECT Name, Size FROM Product WHERE Size = 'M';

question: Show the Name and StandardCost of all products with standard cost less than 50
expected_sql: SELECT Name, StandardCost FROM Product WHERE StandardCost < 50;

question: List the FirstName, LastName, and CompanyName of the first 10 customers
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, CompanyName FROM Customer LIMIT 10;

question: Show the FirstName, LastName, and CompanyName of all customers whose sales person is 'adventure-works\pamela0'
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, CompanyName FROM Customer WHERE SalesPerson = 'adventure-works\pamela0';

question: Show the AddressLine1, City, and StateProvince of all addresses in Canada
expected_sql: SELECT AddressLine1, City, StateProvince FROM Address WHERE CountryRegion = 'Canada';

question: List the Name of all products ordered by their name alphabetically
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Product ORDER BY Name ASC;

question: Find the Name and Weight of all products that have a weight greater than 10000
expected_sql: SELECT Name, Weight FROM Product WHERE Weight > 10000;

question: List the Name of all products that are discontinued
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Product WHERE DiscontinuedDate IS NOT NULL;

question: Find the AddressLine1, City, StateProvince, CountryRegion, and PostalCode of the address with AddressID 10
expected_sql: SELECT AddressLine1, City, StateProvince, CountryRegion, PostalCode FROM Address WHERE AddressID = 10;

question: How many customers are in the database?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;

question: What is the average list price of all products?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(ListPrice) FROM Product;

question: Count the total number of products in each color
expected_sql: SELECT Color, COUNT(*) FROM Product GROUP BY Color;

question: What is the total sales amount (TotalDue) from all orders?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(TotalDue) FROM SalesOrderHeader;

question: Find the maximum standard cost among all products
expected_sql: SELECT MAX(StandardCost) FROM Product;

question: List the Name of all products with their ProductCategory Name
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name, c.Name AS CategoryName FROM Product p JOIN ProductCategory c ON p.ProductCategoryID = c.ProductCategoryID;

question: Find the AddressLine1, City, and StateProvince of all customer addresses for the customer named Orlando Gee
expected_sql: SELECT a.AddressLine1, a.City, a.StateProvince FROM Customer c JOIN CustomerAddress ca ON c.CustomerID = ca.CustomerID JOIN Address a ON ca.AddressID = a.AddressID WHERE c.FirstName = 'Orlando' AND c.LastName = 'Gee';

question: Show all Product Names and their corresponding ProductModel Names
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name, pm.Name AS ModelName FROM Product p JOIN ProductModel pm ON p.ProductModelID = pm.ProductModelID;

question: List the FirstName, LastName, and CompanyName of all customers who have placed an order
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.CompanyName FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID;

question: Get the SalesOrderID, Product Name, OrderQty, and UnitPrice of all sales order details
expected_sql: SELECT sod.SalesOrderID, p.Name, sod.OrderQty, sod.UnitPrice FROM SalesOrderDetail sod JOIN Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID;

question: List all distinct cities and the count of addresses in each city ordered by address count descending
expected_sql: SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS AddressCount FROM Address GROUP BY City ORDER BY AddressCount DESC;

question: Calculate the total subtotal for each customer ID
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerID, SUM(SubTotal) FROM SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY CustomerID;

question: Find the total quantity of products sold for product ID 710
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(OrderQty) FROM SalesOrderDetail WHERE ProductID = 710;

question: List the Name and ParentProductCategoryID of all product categories
expected_sql: SELECT Name, ParentProductCategoryID FROM ProductCategory;

question: Show the Name of all product models that have a description in the CatalogDescription
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM ProductModel WHERE CatalogDescription IS NOT NULL;

question: Show all customer CompanyNames and the SalesOrderIDs they placed
expected_sql: SELECT c.CompanyName, soh.SalesOrderID FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID;

question: Count how many products belong to each product model ID
expected_sql: SELECT ProductModelID, COUNT(*) FROM Product GROUP BY ProductModelID;

question: What is the highest unit price paid for a product in any order?
expected_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM SalesOrderDetail;

question: List the City of all distinct customer addresses
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.City FROM Address a JOIN CustomerAddress ca ON a.AddressID = ca.AddressID;

question: Show the Name and ListPrice of all products in category 'Road Bikes'
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name, p.ListPrice FROM Product p JOIN ProductCategory c ON p.ProductCategoryID = c.ProductCategoryID WHERE c.Name = 'Road Bikes';

question: List the CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, and sum of TotalDue of the top 5 customers who spent the most
expected_sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(soh.TotalDue) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show product descriptions for the product 'Classic Vest, S' in English
expected_sql: SELECT pd.Description FROM Product p JOIN ProductModel pm ON p.ProductModelID = pm.ProductModelID JOIN ProductModelProductDescription pmpd ON pm.ProductModelID = pmpd.ProductModelID JOIN ProductDescription pd ON pmpd.ProductDescriptionID = pd.ProductDescriptionID WHERE p.Name = 'Classic Vest, S' AND pmpd.Culture = 'en';

question: Find the Name and sum of LineTotal as category revenue for each product category ordered by category revenue descending
expected_sql: SELECT c.Name, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS CategoryRevenue FROM SalesOrderDetail sod JOIN Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN ProductCategory c ON p.ProductCategoryID = c.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY c.Name ORDER BY CategoryRevenue DESC;

question: Get the FirstName, LastName, and CompanyName of all customers who ordered the product 'Half-Finger Gloves, L'
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.CompanyName FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID JOIN Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE p.Name = 'Half-Finger Gloves, L';

question: Find the month and year of orders with the highest total sales
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, SUM(TotalDue) AS MonthlySales FROM SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY OrderMonth ORDER BY MonthlySales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each product, list its Name, ProductCategory Name as category name, and ProductModel Name as model name
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, c.Name AS CategoryName, pm.Name AS ModelName FROM Product p JOIN ProductCategory c ON p.ProductCategoryID = c.ProductCategoryID LEFT JOIN ProductModel pm ON p.ProductModelID = pm.ProductModelID;

question: List the CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, and count of shipping addresses for the customer with the most shipping addresses
expected_sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(ca.AddressID) AS AddressCount FROM Customer c JOIN CustomerAddress ca ON c.CustomerID = ca.CustomerID WHERE ca.AddressType = 'Shipping' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY AddressCount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the Name of all products that have never been ordered
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Product p LEFT JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID WHERE sod.ProductID IS NULL;

question: What is the average order value for orders placed in 2008?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(TotalDue) FROM SalesOrderHeader WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2008';

question: Show the FirstName and LastName of all customers who have ordered products from a ProductCategory with name containing 'Bikes'
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID JOIN Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN ProductCategory pc ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID WHERE pc.Name LIKE '%Bikes%';

question: List the Name of all product categories along with the count of products in that category, including categories with no products
expected_sql: SELECT pc.Name, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS ProductCount FROM ProductCategory pc LEFT JOIN Product p ON pc.ProductCategoryID = p.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY pc.Name ORDER BY ProductCount DESC;

question: Find the AddressLine1, City, StateProvince, and CountryRegion of the shipping address for order ID 71780
expected_sql: SELECT a.AddressLine1, a.City, a.StateProvince, a.CountryRegion FROM SalesOrderHeader soh JOIN Address a ON soh.ShipToAddressID = a.AddressID WHERE soh.SalesOrderID = 71780;

question: Find the total quantity of products sold in each year
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', soh.OrderDate) AS SalesYear, SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalQty FROM SalesOrderHeader soh JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID GROUP BY SalesYear;

question: Show the Name of products that have been sold more than 5 times total
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name, SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalSold FROM Product p JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID GROUP BY p.Name HAVING TotalSold > 5;

question: List the FirstName and LastName of all customers who have placed orders with a TotalDue greater than 50000
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID WHERE soh.TotalDue > 50000;
